oneLiner: A tool for splitting shared trip expenses without a spreadsheet.
problem: Groups traveling together struggle to fairly divide expenses and track who owes whom without resorting to error-prone spreadsheets or mental math.
targetUser: Friends and colleagues taking trips together who want a simple, hassle-free way to split costs and settle up.
coreFlow: Create a new trip and invite participants
Add expenses as they occur, specifying who paid and who benefited
View real-time breakdown of who owes whom
Generate settlement summary showing final payments needed

screens.name: Trip Dashboard
screens.purpose: Overview of all active trips with quick access to create new ones

screens.name: Trip Details
screens.purpose: View all expenses for a specific trip and see the current settlement state

screens.name: Add Expense
screens.purpose: Log a new expense with payer, participants, and amount

screens.name: Settlement Summary
screens.purpose: Display who owes whom and simplified payment instructions to settle debts

screens.name: Participant Management
screens.purpose: Add, remove, or manage trip participants and their contact info
